notes.title: Patch Notes: June 12, 2018 (2nd)
notes.content:
"Not supprted platform" issue is solved. 
Since the client with this issue cannot download new patch, you have to reinstall new client.

notes.title: Patch Notes: June 12, 2018
notes.content:
1.	Engine sounds of some of the vehicles are restored.
2.	Specifications of Spiral, Spiral2006 are modified.
3.	Details of Spiral V8 are modified.
4.	Details of Spiral2006 are modified.
5.	Spiral tuning engines are added.
6.	Znoda, SPIKE shop are now visible.
7.	Vehicles including AF36 tuned and AE chrome (M3 CSL) are now visible when unlocked.
8.	L3 license can now be completed, allowing progression to L4.
9.	Kreus GZ30V and Mcquoidd Goat G2 modelling are restored and visible.
10.	Some names of the track are corrected or modified.
11.	Notifications or warnings popping up in system language were modified and typos corrected.
12.	Silver medal reward modified when completing L3 license.
13.	Conditions for L5 license mission #10 are modified. 
14.	MAKSAR, and Bussi Lightweight, both racing cars, are added.

Special thanks to ACEBUDDY for his input on the patch as well as his dedication and devotion to enhancement of the game.
